Commentary.Commentary: Now then, 143 to inflict a whitewash. Looking at the wicket and the track record, one would feel that Afghanistan can chase the total without much difficulty. Let's see if Ireland can do something with the ball to manage a win in this final game. Join us for the run chase in a while.

The Afghans were excellent with the ball. Naveen-ul-Haq struck in the very first over and went on to take 2 more. Qais Ahmad, the debutant, was superb too as he ended up picking 3 wickets. Rashid and Mujeeb kept things tight too as they shared 2 wickets for 56 runs in their combined 8 over spell.

After opting to bat, Ireland started very poorly as they lost Paul Stirling in the very first over. Andy Balbirnie, the skipper, too failed to leave any mark. Kevin O'Brien and Gareth Delany then stitched a very good 62-run stand to bring Ireland back in the game. Till the duo were batting, it looked like Ireland will get to a good first innings total. However, once that partnership was broken, Ireland lost the way and kept losing wickets at regular intervals. Tector's 31 meant that Ireland managed to get to a respectable total in the end but it is surely short of an average total on this batting-friendly wicket.

Excellent bowling performance from Afghanistan. At the toss, the Afghan skipper had said that they will look to keep Ireland to around 150 and they have managed to hold them well below it. Quality stuff from the hosts.
Length delivery outside off, Singh comes down the track and punches it through mid off. The batsmen get two runs. IRELAND FINISH ON 142/8!
FOUR! Short of a length delivery, Singh looks to pull but gets a top edge. It goes over the keeper and towards the third man fence for a boundary.
WIDE! Naib bowls it wide outside off, Singh offers no shot to this one.
Full delivery on middle, Singh comes down the track and drives it through mid on. Nabi from long on does well to stop it. The batsmen get two runs.
Slower bouncer, Young waits and then tucks it towards mid-wicket for a quick run.
Another play and a miss! This one is a fuller one and outside off. Young once again fails to get any bat on the ball. Two dots in a row.
Swing and a miss! A slower delivery again which is on a length and outside off, Young swings hard but misses.
Gulbadin Naib to bowl the last over of the innings.
Rashid spots Young skipping down the track. He drops it short and bowls it quicker. Craig does well to tap it towards the off side for a single.

EDGY FOUR! Floated and on off, Young goes for the drive but gets a thick inside edge and the ball rolls past the leg pole and beats the effort of the short fine leg fielder as the ball rolls to the fence.
Floated and on off, pushed to mid off for a single.
Floated on leg, Young tucks it to mid on for a single.

Huge shout for LBW! The umpire is unmoved. Rashid bowls a googly outside off, The ball comes back into the batter as he misses his flick and gets hit flush on the pads. Rashid Khan looks excited but the umpire is not interested.
Floated on the pads, Singh tucks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Rashid Khan to bowl the penultimate over of the innings. 3-0-16-1 are his figures so far.
Full and on the pads, this one is worked towards mid-wicket for a run. 2 runs and a wicket from the over.
Excellent bowling! Full and outside off, Simi looks to squeeze it out but misses.
Craig Young is the next batsman in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Another one bites the dust. It is a slower length ball outside off, McCarthy looks to go for the big hit but he fails to get underneath the ball as he ends up lofting it towards mid off where Rashid takes an easy catch.
Wide yorker outside the off pole and Barry looks to cut it but he fails to get any wood behind that ball.
Length and on middle, flicked towards mid-wicket for a single by Singh.
Slower short ball outside off and Simi Singh who is waiting on the back foot to tee off gets surprised as the ball reaches him late than he expected.
Barry McCarthy is the new man in. Naveen-ul-Haq to bowl out. 3-0-19-2 are his figures so far.

OUT! CAUGHT! Two in two for Qais. A wicket to finish the spell from Qais. He is a delighted man. Full and just outside off, Getkate goes for the sweep but once again there is no timing. The ball goes straight to Najibullah at deep mid-wicket. He takes it with ease. Ireland sink further. Ahmad finishes with 3/25.
Simi Singh is the new batsman in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Tector once again goes for the slog on this floated ball on middle but he fails to get it off the middle of the bat. The ball goes towards deep mid-wicket where Najibullah Zadran takes the catch. Decent hand from Tector comes to an end.
In the air... but safe. Another floated ball on off, Getkate lofts it over mid off but the ball falls in no man's land for a single.
Flatter and outside off, Tector cuts it through point for a single.
Floated around off, punched to the off side for a single.
Play and  a miss! It is floated outside off, Getkate lines up for a big heave but connects with just thin air. The keeper whips the bails too but Shane was going nowhere.
Qais Ahmad to bowl out. 3-0-22-1 from him so far.
Another slower one. Getkate drives it towards long off for a single.
Takes the pace off this time and bowls it wide too. Tector can only push it towards point for a quick run.
SIX! HUGE! What a strike from Tector. He gets this ball in his arc. He connects it and sends it sailing way over the long on fence for a huge six.
Landed around off and middle, this one is pushed through mid on for a single.
Slower and around off, Tector looks to heave it over the leg side but he fails to time it well. The ball goes towards long on for a run.
Play and a miss! Good length ball outside off, Tector swings hard but fails to connect.
Gulbadin Naib to bowl now.
Play and a miss! Getkate once again gets beaten on the forward push as the ball spins away after pitching around off.
Floated and on the pads, flicked to mid-wicket for a single.
Floated on off, Tector drives it to covers where Mohammad Nabi does a very good job as he stops it.
Floated on off, Getkate lofts it over the mid off fielder and they cross for a single.
BEATEN! Floated around off, Getkate looks to push it to the off side but gets beaten in the outside edge.
Full and on the pads, worked behind square leg for a single.
Floated around off and a bit of bounce on that. Getkate stays on the back foot and keeps it out. Mujeeb Ur Rahman finishes his spell with figures of 4-0-32-1.
Shane Getkate is the new man in.

OUT! Bowled 'em! Mujeeb has a wicket too. He fires this one flatter and around off and middle, Tucker looks to go inside out over cover but he misses. The ball though does not miss its mark and disturbs the middle pole. Half the Irish side are back into the pavilion.
Quick single! Full and around off, Tector reverse sweeps it towards short third man for a single.
The batsman tried to sweep that one but missed it and was hit on the pads. One run added to the total. Leg byes signalled by the umpire.
Floated delivery on off, Tector plays it towards point for a single.
Flatter and on middle, Tucker works it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Mujeeb Ur Rahman to bowl out. 3-0-29-0 are his figures so far.

SIX! Powerful hit! Khan floats one on off, and Tector lofts it over the long on region where the fielder was interested but the ball goes over him and into the fence there. Rashid Khan is not too happy with the effort of the fielder there. 100 up for Ireland there.
Floated and on middle, Tucker tucks it to square leg and goes for a single. Rahmanullah Gurbaz runs to that side and prevents a couple.
Floated and on middle, Tucker keeps it out off the front foot.
Floated and on off, Tector drives it powerfully but straight to long off for a single.
Floated and around off, pushed to long off for a single.
Floated delivery on middle, Tucker drives it through mid on for a run.
Full delivery on off, Tucker drives it through covers for a single.
FOUR! Nice improvisation! Loopy delivery on off, Tucker plays a reverse sweep towards third man for a boundary.
Flighted delivery on off, Tector looks to defend but gets an outside edge. It goes towards third man. The batsmen cross ends.
Floated delivery on off, Tucker drives it through mid off for a single.
It's been driven superbly through the covers. They pick up a single.
EDGY FOUR! Tossed up ball on middle, Tector looks to loft it over cover but gets a thick outside edge. It goes through gully and into the fence in the deep.
Tossed up delivery on off, Tucker drives it to covers.
Floated delivery on off, Tucker plays it towards covers for a single.
Lorcan Tucker joins Harry Tector in the middle. A slip comes in place.

OUT! CAUGHT! The superstar strikes in his first over. It is floated on off, Delany goes for the  hit but it was played half-heartedly. The ball goes high up in the air and Mohammad Nabi has to just settle himself under the ball at long off and take the catch which he does to good effect. Delany's handy knock comes to an end.
Full delivery on middle, Tector drives it through mid on for a run.
Floated delivery on middle, Delany lofts it over mid on for a single.
Flighted delivery on middle, Tector drives it through mid on for a single.
Time for the superstar, Rashid Khan, to bowl now.
Floated delivery on off, Delany defends it off the back foot.
On middle, Delany blocks it off the front foot.
Flighted delivery on off, Tector punches it through covers for a single.
Loopy delivery on off, Delany plays it towards covers for a run. The fielder goes for a direct hit at the bowler's end but misses it.
Floated delivery on middle, Tector drives it through mid on for a single and gets off the mark.
Harry Tector walks in next.

OUT! CAUGHT! Maiden T20I wicket for Qais Ahmad. A wonderful catch by Rashid Khan. It is a tossed up delivery on off, inviting the batsman to go for the hit. Kevin O'Brien obliges as he lofts it without any proper timing. The ball goes high up in the air but fails to cross the fence as Rashid Khan at long off comes forward and pouches the catch nicely. The 62-run stand is broken.
Full and around off, O'Brien pushes it towards covers and takes a single.
Short and wide outside off, cut towards deep point for a single.
Uppish but safe! Full and around off, Delany lofts it over wide mid on. The long on fielder comes ahead quickly and gets to the ball but he cannot stop the batters in taking a couple.
Full and outside off, O'Brien backs away and drills it straight to sweeper cover for a run.
FOUR! Excellent timing! Janat bowls it full and just outside off, O'Brien hammers it through point. He opens the bat face and squeezes it to the fence at deep point.
Good length ball on middle, Delany strokes it to long on for a single.
Tossed up delivery on off, Delany punches it through covers for a run.
Full delivery on off, O'Brien drives it through mid off for a single.
Loopy delivery on off, Kevin punches it towards point.
Flighted delivery on middle, O'Brien defends it off the front foot.
Fuller and around off, stroked through covers for a single. 50-run stand is up between Delany and O'Brien.

EDGY FOUR! Wow, he wasn't too far away from getting a wicket on the very first ball of his T20I career. He bowls it shortish and just outside off, Delany looks to cut but gets an inside edge. The ball just about passes the stumps and races away to the fence at third man.
Qais Ahmed, the debutant, is into the attack now.
Landed around off on a shortish length, Delany strokes it towards sweeper cover for a single.
EDGY FOUR! Fuller and outside off, Delany throws his bat at it to drive but gets a thick outside edge. The ball goes to the third man fence quickly.
A bouncer now! Excellent variation from Janat. He bangs this around off, Delany swings but fails to connect.
Full and just outside off, Delany squeezes it towards point where the fielder does well to stop the ball with a dive to his right.
WIDE! Tries to stay away from the hitting zone but ends up bowling it wide outside off. Delany lets it be. Wided by the umpire.
Shortish and outside off, O'Brien cuts but finds point.
Full and just outside off from Janat to start his over. O'Brien strokes it to sweeper cover for a single.
Karim Janat is into the attack.
Flatter and around off, pushed through mid on for a single. 17 from the over. 50 up for Ireland at the end of Powerplay.
Full and around off, Delany strokes it towards mid off where Nabi fumbles and allows a single.
SIX! Massive! Mujeeb is getting hammered here. He bowls a fuller one in the slot for Delany who tonks it over wide long on for a biggie.
FOUR! It was in the air but just about eluded Nabi at mid off. Full and outside off from Mujeeb. Delany hammers it over mid off. Nabi there leaps high and tries to catch but fails to get hands to it.
FOUR! Short and wide from Mujeeb and Delany pounces on it. He goes on the back foot and slams it through cover-point to bag another boundary.
Tossed up delivery on middle, O'Brien drives it through mid on for a single.

MISFIELD AND FOUR! Mohammad Nabi is the man with a very poor effort at mid off. He has his hands up in apology. Full and around off, Delany hammers it towards mid off. It goes straight to Nabi who fails to get down in time and allows the ball to go through. It was hit powerfully and hence once it went past Nabi, it raced away to the fence.
Another length ball around off, Delany pushes it towards cover-point.
Fullish and around off, O'Brien pushes it towards point for a quick run.
Landed around off on a length, O'Brien pushes it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Through the covers this time. Full and outside off, O'Brien this time drills it through covers and the ball races away to the fence in a jiffy.
WIDE! Down the leg side now, O'Brien looks to pull but misses. Wided by the umpire.
FOUR! Thumped through point! Naveen offers width outside off on a shortish length, O'Brien rocks on the back foot and slams it through point to bag a boundary.
Flighted and on off, Delany blocks it off the back foot to the off side.
Floated and on off, Delany plays it to point.
Floated and on middle, Kevin pushes it to mid on and gets to the other end.

FOUR! Beautifully played! Mujeeb tosses one up and Kevin comes down the track and lofts it over the covers. Though he fails to get to the pitch of the ball but has enough for the ball to get to the boundary.
Tossed up on a length and on the pads, Delany pushes it to mid on for a single.
Length ball on the pads, Kevin tucks it to short fine leg and gets to the other end. A leg bye signalled.
On a good length on off, Delany keeps it out.
Shortish and around off, this one is cut towards covers.
Full and on middle, Delany pushes it towards mid on.
Outside off, Delany offers no shot to this one.
Gareth Delany is the new man in.

OUT! TIMBER! Naveen strikes again and this time the off stump has gone for a walk. Absolute ripper from the young man. Good length ball outside off, it comes in with the angle. Balbirnie looks to drive without any feet movement. He misses and the ball thumps the off pole behind. The Irish skipper has been removed and Ireland in a spot of bother very early in this game.
Full toss on off, O'Brien drives it towards point for a single.
Flatter and on middle, worked towards mid-wicket for a single.
Full and outside off, Balbirnie drives it towards covers where Rashid makes a diving stop and saves runs for his side. The batters can only get a single.
FOUR! Swept away! Full and outside off, Balbirnie gets in position and sweeps it through square leg for a boundary.
On off, blocked.
Full and down the leg side, O'Brien looks to sweep but misses to get hit on the pads. The ball rolls towards the leg side and they take a leg bye.
This could be a very interesting passage of play. Ireland have lost Paul Stirling quickly and hence, a good Powerplay might be deterred.
Mujeeb starts with a loopy ball just outside off, O'Brien works it towards mid-wicket.

FOUR! The skipper is off the mark in style! Naveen bowls it very full and outside off, Balbirnie creams it through the covers and the ball races away to the fence. 4 runs and a wicket from the very first over.
Good length ball around off, this one is pushed towards covers.

OUT! CAUGHT! Naveen strikes in the very first over. It is a soft dismissal. Full and just outside off, Stirling looks to chip it over mid off but he fails to time it well. He can only manage it to lob it towards Nabi at that position who takes the catch easily. Afghanistan have early success. Andy Balbirnie is the new batsman in.
On the pads, this one is flicked towards mid-wicket.
Full and around off, Stirling pushes it back to the bowler.
Beaten first ball. Good start from Naveen-ul-Haq. He lands this length ball outside off and makes it to come into the right-hander. Stirling pokes at it to get beaten.
